reported_sample_status: unverified identification, not an observed dataset

gates.name: Identify the actual reported day and all 21 trades
gates.required: Full actor address, date/timezone, immutable source, all source and destination tx hashes and chains, contract/mint addresses, amounts/decimals, bridge message IDs, completion and failed/pending outcomes. Abbreviations or token labels do not identify a dataset.

gates.name: Prove a matching perp was tradable at each decision time
gates.required: Historical venue/DEX namespace, listing and delisting witnesses, exact underlying/index and multiplier, collateral token, trading halts, position/OI limits, trader eligibility. Current metadata is not a historical listing witness.

gates.name: Recover executable entry and close prices for size
gates.required: Timestamped pre-decision bid/ask/depth or matching fills, sizes, clock alignment, latency, partial/rejected orders and exit availability. Never replace these with OHLC, hourly/interpolated/filled marks, allMids or a current book.

gates.name: Identify the exposure and when the hedge starts and stops
gates.required: Token/claim equivalence, borrow liabilities and collateral deltas, numeraire and FX, spot purchase time, hedge-entry time, finality/bridge completion, actual sale and hedge-close time. A borrowed-token liability can already offset inventory delta.

gates.name: Reconstruct margin and total capital through the path
gates.required: Historical margin tiers/mode/account abstraction, separate collateral pools, equity/mark path, liquidation/ADL and withdrawal constraints. Count spot cash, hedge collateral/buffers, destination loan collateral, gas reserves and in-flight funds within one total capital budget.

gates.name: Account for all actual costs and funding events
gates.required: Entry and close maker/taker fees, historical user tier/referral/staking settings, HIP-3 deployer/growth/collateral factors, explicit builder fee without double-counting, actual hourly funding events/signs, spot impact, bridge fee, gas, borrowing, conversions and infrastructure allocation. Unknown is not zero.

gates.name: Keep full sample and terminal positions
gates.required: Fixed 21-row sample, no selecting losers or dropping failed bridges; carry open inventory/debt/perps and unrealized marks separately from received cash. No automatic extension to a month.

minimal_valid_test_if_inputs_are_later_r: Freeze the complete identified 21-trade manifest and versioned sources before examining improvement.

For each row, require the historically matching hedge contract and a size-aware sell-bid entry followed by buy-ask close after the predeclared exit condition; mark unavailable rows unavailable, not zero profit.

Reconcile spot/bridge cash flows, debt and hedge/funding cash flows with one capital and margin path. Hold the original spot fills fixed only as an explicit counterfactual assumption, not a causal execution guarantee.
Report paired unhedged versus hedged economics, all extra capital/costs, failed fills, pending exposure and sample coverage. No T2, monthly claim or riskless conclusion from this test.

analytical_identity_not_a_replay.assumptions: Same economic units, linear contract, fixed spot quantity q and short quantity h; actual receipt quantities/fees must replace this simplification.
analytical_identity_not_a_replay.equation: economic_PnL = q*(destination_spot_exit - source_spot_entry) + h*(perp_bid_entry - perp_ask_exit) + signed_funding - all_other_costs
analytical_identity_not_a_replay.interpretation: For a correctly sized hedge, common price delta may cancel. Destination local basis, perp-index basis, execution gaps, missing token receipts, margin liquidation and counterparty risk do not cancel. Adding a short can change winners as well as losers.
